title: L9 Generated Data Ingress Receipt
description: Formalizes the existing l9.generated-data-ingress-receipt.v1 written by ingress/receipts.py write_ingress. It is the harvest-plane audit record: which source was considered (acceptance_receipt_digest, source_kind), what happened (outcome, processing_status, reason), and where downstream proof lives (processor_job_id, packet_evidence_path, delivery). It carries references, not evidence bodies, and does not model memory admission, dedup, or supersession, which the canonical memory owner decides. Law §36.

acceptance_receipt_digest.description: Source identity and the source-processing idempotency key: one receipt file per digest. Not a semantic-memory dedup key.

source_kind.description: Which existing producer handed the source to ingress.

outcome.description: Harvest disposition. CAPTURED = processed (see processing_status); NO_REUSABLE_DATA = successful no-op; QUARANTINED / REJECTED = refused; FAILED = processing could not complete. FAILED is never NO_REUSABLE_DATA.

packet_evidence_path.description: Reference to the raw packet evidence. Repository/campaign/action scope is read from its identity block rather than copied here.

delivery.description: Delivery-worker result reference (route outcomes, destination receipt ids) or null when no delivery ran.

allOf.description: Nothing to preserve routes nothing: no job, no processing, no evidence packet.
A quarantined source never reaches the processor, and its evidence stays addressable.
A captured source is bound to a processor job and its evidence.
A processing error is only ever reported as a failure or a refusal, never as success or a no-op.
